title.purpose: Names an informative sub-view only when it adds context.

shadows.name: temporary-layer
shadows.purpose: Dialog sheets and temporary raised layers only.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single valid next action in a decision region.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--signal-decision); color: var(--text-inverse); border: 1px solid var(--signal-decision); border-radius: var(--radius-md); padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-5); font: inherit; font-weight: var(--weight-medium); transition: background var(--motion-hover) var(--easing-default), transform var(--motion-press) var(--easing-default); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--signal-decision-strong); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.98); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: var(--text-primary); border: 1px solid var(--boundary-standard); border-radius: var(--radius-md); padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-5); font: inherit; font-weight: var(--weight-medium); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--material-surface-recessed); border-color: var(--focus-ring); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Labeled Field
components.description: A visible label and contained operational input.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: var(--space-2); color: var(--text-primary); font-weight: var(--weight-medium); } .ds-field input { min-height: var(--control-height); padding: var(--space-3); border: 1px solid var(--boundary-standard); border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--material-control); color: var(--text-primary); font: inherit; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Current Navigation Item
components.description: Goal-oriented navigation with explicit current location.
components.css: .ds-nav-current { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: var(--control-height); padding: var(--space-3); border-inline-start: 2px solid var(--signal-decision); background: var(--material-selection); color: var(--text-primary); text-decoration: none; font-weight: var(--weight-semibold); } .ds-nav-current:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Catalog Row
components.description: Continuous object identity, state, scan facts, and one next action.
components.html:
PS-780 Operator Control Exercise

Open · 11/11 readiness · 1 participant
components.css: .ds-catalog-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) auto; gap: var(--space-4); align-items: center; padding: var(--space-4); border-block-end: 1px solid var(--boundary-subtle); background: var(--material-surface); color: var(--text-primary); } .ds-catalog-row p { margin: var(--space-1) 0 0; color: var(--text-secondary); } .ds-row-action { min-height: var(--control-height); padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-5); border: 1px solid var(--signal-decision); border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--signal-decision); color: var(--text-inverse); font: inherit; font-weight: var(--weight-medium); }

narrative.overview: A contained professional instrument with editorial reading order, a dominant work region, and conscientious continuity through every state change.

rules.name: Decision Accent
rules.body: Mineral Sage marks selection, focus, and the single primary action; it is not decoration.

rules.name: Subject Before Annotation
rules.body: Object and action lead; supporting prose remains optional or secondary.

rules.name: Temporary Elevation
rules.body: Persistent regions use boundaries; temporary regions use elevation.

dos: Keep evidence beside the decision it affects.
Preserve focus, selection, and task order.
donts: Do not create card mosaics or decorative surfaces.
Do not animate routine reading or imply false completion.
